title: ==SDET SENIOR TEST LEAD==  |  API & WEB AUTOMATION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==SDET Senior Test Lead== with 15+ years of QA experience, including API testing, web automation, framework enhancement and release delivery. Hands-on with Java, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber/BDD, Postman, SQL and Jenkins/Git pipelines. Leads and contributes across test planning and execution, defect analysis, team mentoring and stakeholder communication in financial services and retirement software.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Led and contributed to test activities across the STLC, preparing scenarios, test cases, estimates and execution plans from requirements.
Performed API testing with Postman and validated application reports and database data using SQL.
Automated sprint requirements using Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD and maintained the regression suite.
Enhanced and maintained Selenium frameworks, reviewed peer code and developed utilities for report validation, PDF comparison and file handling.
Executed weekly regression through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines, configured Jenkins jobs and analyzed test results.
Triaged defects, retested fixes, communicated test status and technical risks, and coordinated QA/Production deployments.
Mentored QA colleagues and partnered with cross-functional teams on testing priorities and release readiness.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
bullets: Tested integrated customer communications workflows for retirement and financial products across print, email and online channels.
Environment included Postman, SQL, Selenium, Java, Cucumber, Maven, FTP, PDFBox and Axiom.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Executed Selenium/QTP regression and developed Selenium scripts for eCompliance across retirement applications.
